questions.question: What does Psalm 81 call the people to do?
options: Sing aloud to God with joy and blow the trumpet at the feast
Weep and fast in rough sackcloth on account of your sins
Bring forward your offerings and lay them upon the altar
Bow down in deep silence and wait very patiently upon the LORD
questions.answer: Sing aloud to God with joy and blow the trumpet at the feast

questions.question: What does God promise if his people open their mouths wide?
God laments that his people did not listen, so he gave them over to their stubborn hearts.
Open your mouth wide, and I will _____ it.
Oh, that my people would _____ to me, that Israel would walk in my ways!
